# Paired t-test sample size calculation
# Parameters from user request
mean_reduction <- 3      # kg (effect size: expected weight reduction)
sd_baseline <- 5         # kg
sd_followup <- 5.5       # kg
r <- 0.5                 # within-person correlation
alpha <- 0.05           # significance level
target_power <- 0.80    # target power
sidedness <- "one"      # one-sided test

# Step 1: Calculate SD of the differences
# SD_diff = sqrt(SD_baseline^2 + SD_followup^2 - 2*r*SD_baseline*SD_followup)
sd_diff <- sqrt(sd_baseline^2 + sd_followup^2 - 2*r*sd_baseline*sd_followup)

cat("Standard Deviation of Differences:\n")
cat("SD_diff = √(5² + 5.5² - 2×0.5×5×5.5)\n")
cat("SD_diff = √(25 + 30.25 - 27.5)\n")
cat("SD_diff =", sd_diff, "kg\n\n")

# Step 2: Calculate standardized effect size (Cohen's d equivalent)
effect_size <- mean_reduction / sd_diff
cat("Standardized effect size (d):\n")
cat("d = mean_reduction / SD_diff =", mean_reduction, "/", sd_diff, "=", effect_size, "\n\n")

# Step 3: Use power.t.test to find minimum sample size
# For one-sided test with target power 0.80
library(stats)

# Solve for sample size using power.t.test
# type = "paired" for paired samples
# alternative = "one.sided" for one-sided test
result <- power.t.test(
  n = NULL,                    # solve for n
  delta = effect_size,         # standardized effect size (mean_reduction / sd_diff)
  sd = 1,                      # sd is already incorporated in delta
  sig.level = alpha,
  power = target_power,
  type = "paired",
  alternative = "one.sided"
)

n_continuous <- result$n
cat("Continuous solution from power.t.test:\n")
cat("Sample size (continuous):", n_continuous, "participants\n\n")

# Step 4: Round up to nearest integer
n_integer <- ceiling(n_continuous)
cat("Minimum integer sample size:", n_integer, "participants\n\n")

# Step 5: Verify achieved power at the selected sample size
power_at_n_selected <- power.t.test(
  n = n_integer,
  delta = effect_size,
  sd = 1,
  sig.level = alpha,
  type = "paired",
  alternative = "one.sided"
)$power

cat("Power verification at n =", n_integer, ":", power_at_n_selected, "\n\n")

# Step 6: Check power at preceding integer sample size (if different)
n_preceding <- n_integer - 1
if (n_preceding >= 1) {
  power_at_n_preceding <- power.t.test(
    n = n_preceding,
    delta = effect_size,
    sd = 1,
    sig.level = alpha,
    type = "paired",
    alternative = "one.sided"
  )$power
  
  cat("Power at preceding design (n =", n_preceding, "):", power_at_n_preceding, "\n\n")
}

# Summary output
cat("========== FINAL RESULTS ==========\n")
cat("Method: Paired t-test (one-sided, α = 0.05)\n")
cat("Target power: 80%\n")
cat("Mean weight reduction: 3 kg\n")
cat("SD of differences: ", round(sd_diff, 4), " kg\n")
cat("Standardized effect size: ", round(effect_size, 4), "\n")
cat("=====================================\n")
cat("MINIMUM SAMPLE SIZE: ", n_integer, " participants\n")
cat("Achieved power at n =", n_integer, ":", round(power_at_n_selected, 4), "\n")

# Return structured results
results <- data.frame(
  metric = c("sample_size", "sd_of_differences", "standardized_effect_size", 
             "achieved_power_at_selected_n", "achieved_power_at_preceding_n"),
  value = c(n_integer, sd_diff, effect_size, power_at_n_selected, 
            if(exists("power_at_n_preceding")) power_at_n_preceding else NA),
  unit = c("participants_total", "kg", "dimensionless", "proportion", "proportion")
)

POWER_AGENT_RESULT = jsonlite::toJSON(
  list(results = results),
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  digits = 15
)

# Independent verification of paired t-test sample size calculation
# Using both power.t.test and manual non-centrality parameter approach

library(stats)

# Given parameters
mean_reduction <- 3
sd_baseline <- 5
sd_followup <- 5.5
r <- 0.5
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.80
sidedness <- "one.sided"

# ===== VERIFICATION 1: SD of differences calculation =====
# For paired data: Var(D) = Var(X) + Var(Y) - 2*Cov(X,Y)
# where Cov(X,Y) = r * SD_X * SD_Y
# So SD_D = sqrt(SD_X^2 + SD_Y^2 - 2*r*SD_X*SD_Y)

sd_diff_manual <- sqrt(sd_baseline^2 + sd_followup^2 - 2*r*sd_baseline*sd_followup)

cat("=== VERIFICATION 1: SD of Differences ===\n")
cat("Formula: SD_diff = sqrt(SD_baseline² + SD_followup² - 2*r*SD_baseline*SD_followup)\n")
cat("SD_diff = sqrt(25 + 30.25 - 2*0.5*5*5.5)\n")
cat("SD_diff = sqrt(25 + 30.25 - 27.5)\n")
cat("SD_diff = sqrt(27.75)\n")
cat("Calculated SD_diff:", sd_diff_manual, "kg\n\n")

# ===== VERIFICATION 2: Standardized effect size =====
effect_size_manual <- mean_reduction / sd_diff_manual
cat("=== VERIFICATION 2: Standardized Effect Size ===\n")
cat("Cohen's d = mean_reduction / SD_diff\n")
cat("Cohen's d =", mean_reduction, "/", sd_diff_manual, "=", effect_size_manual, "\n\n")

# ===== VERIFICATION 3: Manual non-centrality parameter and sample size via t-distribution =====
# For a paired t-test:
# Non-centrality parameter: λ = d * sqrt(n)
# where d is Cohen's d and n is sample size
# 
# Power is P(t_{n-1,λ} > t_{α,n-1}) for one-sided test
# We need to find n such that power ≈ 0.80

cat("=== VERIFICATION 3: Manual Power Calculation via Non-Centrality Parameter ===\n")

# Test at n = 20 and n = 21
for (n_test in c(20, 21)) {
  ncp <- effect_size_manual * sqrt(n_test)
  # Critical value for one-sided test at alpha=0.05
  t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df = n_test - 1)
  # Power: P(t > t_crit | ncp)
  power_manual <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df = n_test - 1, ncp = ncp)
  
  cat("n =", n_test, ": ncp =", sprintf("%.6f", ncp), 
      ", t_crit =", sprintf("%.4f", t_crit),
      ", power =", sprintf("%.8f", power_manual), "\n")
}

cat("\n")

  n = NULL,
  delta = effect_size_manual,
  sd = 1,
  sig.level = alpha,
  power = target_power,
  type = "paired",
  alternative = "one.sided"
)

  sd = 1,
  sig.level = alpha,
  type = "paired",
  alternative = "one.sided"
)

cat("Power at n = 21:", result_n21$power, "\n")

  delta = effect_size_manual,
  sd = 1,
  sig.level = alpha,
  type = "paired",
  alternative = "one.sided"

cat("=== MATHEMATICAL DERIVATION OF SD OF DIFFERENCES ===\n\n")

# Given: baseline and follow-up measurements for each person
# X_i = baseline weight for person i
# Y_i = follow-up weight for person i  
# D_i = Y_i - X_i = weight reduction (change score)

# We are given:
# Var(X) = 5^2 = 25 kg^2
# Var(Y) = 5.5^2 = 30.25 kg^2
# Corr(X, Y) = 0.5, so Cov(X,Y) = r * SD_X * SD_Y = 0.5 * 5 * 5.5 = 13.75 kg^2

sd_x <- 5
sd_y <- 5.5
r <- 0.5

var_x <- sd_x^2
var_y <- sd_y^2
cov_xy <- r * sd_x * sd_y

cat("Variance of baseline (X):", var_x, "kg²\n")
cat("Variance of follow-up (Y):", var_y, "kg²\n")
cat("Covariance(X, Y) = r * SD_X * SD_Y =", r, "×", sd_x, "×", sd_y, "=", cov_xy, "kg²\n\n")

# For difference D = Y - X:
# Var(D) = Var(Y - X) = Var(Y) + Var(X) - 2*Cov(Y, X)
#        = Var(Y) + Var(X) - 2*Cov(X, Y)  [by symmetry of covariance]

var_d <- var_y + var_x - 2*cov_xy
sd_d <- sqrt(var_d)

cat("Variance of difference (D = Y - X):\n")
cat("Var(D) = Var(Y) + Var(X) - 2*Cov(X,Y)\n")
cat("Var(D) =", var_y, "+", var_x, "- 2×", cov_xy, "\n")
cat("Var(D) =", var_y + var_x, "-", 2*cov_xy, "\n")
cat("Var(D) =", var_d, "kg²\n\n")

cat("Standard deviation of difference:\n")
cat("SD(D) = √", var_d, "=", sd_d, "kg\n\n")

# ===== VERIFY TEST SPECIFICATION =====
cat("=== TEST SPECIFICATION VERIFICATION ===\n")
cat("Hypothesis test:\n")
cat("  H₀: μ_D = 0 (no mean weight reduction)\n")
cat("  H₁: μ_D = 3 kg (one-sided, directional test for reduction > 0)\n")
cat("  Α level: 0.05 (one-sided critical region)\n")
cat("  Alternative hypothesis: 'greater' (μ > 0)\n\n")

cat("Test statistic under H₀:\n")
cat("  t = (μ̂_D - 0) / (SD_D / √n) ~ t_{n-1}\n")
cat("  where μ̂_D is sample mean difference and SD_D is sample SD of differences\n\n")

cat("Effect size under H₁:\n")
cat("  True μ_D = 3 kg\n")
cat("  Non-centrality: λ = (μ_D / SD_D) × √n = (3 / 5.2678) × √n\n")
cat("  Cohen's d = μ_D / SD_D = 3 / 5.2678 = 0.5695 (medium effect)\n\n")

# ===== VERIFY CRITICAL VALUE CALCULATION =====
cat("=== CRITICAL VALUE AND POWER CALCULATION ===\n")

alpha <- 0.05
n_test <- 21
df <- n_test - 1

# One-sided test: reject H₀ if t > t_{α, n-1}
t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df = df)

cat("Degrees of freedom: n - 1 =", df, "\n")
cat("One-sided test: reject H₀ if t >", sprintf("%.4f", t_crit), "\n\n")

# Non-centrality parameter under H₁
effect_d <- 3 / sd_d
ncp <- effect_d * sqrt(n_test)

cat("Under H₁ (μ_D = 3):\n")

cat("Power = 1 - Pt(", sprintf("%.4f", t_crit), " ; df=", df, ", ncp=", sprintf("%.6f", ncp), ")\n")

# Detailed mathematical verification of paired t-test formulas

cat("=== MATHEMATICAL DERIVATION OF SD OF DIFFERENCES ===\n\n")

# Given: baseline and follow-up measurements for each person
# X_i = baseline weight for person i
# Y_i = follow-up weight for person i  
# D_i = Y_i - X_i = weight reduction (change score)

# We are given:
# Var(X) = 5^2 = 25 kg^2
# Var(Y) = 5.5^2 = 30.25 kg^2
# Corr(X, Y) = 0.5, so Cov(X,Y) = r * SD_X * SD_Y = 0.5 * 5 * 5.5 = 13.75 kg^2

sd_x <- 5
sd_y <- 5.5
r <- 0.5

var_x <- sd_x^2
var_y <- sd_y^2
cov_xy <- r * sd_x * sd_y

cat("Variance of baseline (X):", var_x, "kg²\n")
cat("Variance of follow-up (Y):", var_y, "kg²\n")
cat("Covariance(X, Y) = r * SD_X * SD_Y =", r, "×", sd_x, "×", sd_y, "=", cov_xy, "kg²\n\n")

# For difference D = Y - X:
# Var(D) = Var(Y - X) = Var(Y) + Var(X) - 2*Cov(Y, X)
#        = Var(Y) + Var(X) - 2*Cov(X, Y)  [by symmetry of covariance]

var_d <- var_y + var_x - 2*cov_xy
sd_d <- sqrt(var_d)

cat("Variance of difference (D = Y - X):\n")
cat("Var(D) = Var(Y) + Var(X) - 2*Cov(X,Y)\n")
cat("Var(D) =", var_y, "+", var_x, "- 2×", cov_xy, "\n")
cat("Var(D) =", var_y + var_x, "-", 2*cov_xy, "\n")
cat("Var(D) =", var_d, "kg²\n\n")

cat("Standard deviation of difference:\n")
cat("SD(D) = √", var_d, "=", sd_d, "kg\n\n")

# ===== VERIFY TEST SPECIFICATION =====
cat("=== TEST SPECIFICATION VERIFICATION ===\n")
cat("Hypothesis test:\n")
cat("  H₀: μ_D = 0 (no mean weight reduction)\n")
cat("  H₁: μ_D = 3 kg (one-sided, directional test for reduction > 0)\n")
cat("  Α level: 0.05 (one-sided critical region)\n")
cat("  Alternative hypothesis: 'greater' (μ > 0)\n\n")

cat("Test statistic under H₀:\n")
cat("  t = (μ̂_D - 0) / (SD_D / √n) ~ t_{n-1}\n")
cat("  where μ̂_D is sample mean difference and SD_D is sample SD of differences\n\n")

cat("Effect size under H₁:\n")
cat("  True μ_D = 3 kg\n")
cat("  Non-centrality: λ = (μ_D / SD_D) × √n = (3 / 5.2678) × √n\n")
cat("  Cohen's d = μ_D / SD_D = 3 / 5.2678 = 0.5695 (medium effect)\n\n")

# ===== VERIFY CRITICAL VALUE CALCULATION =====
cat("=== CRITICAL VALUE AND POWER CALCULATION ===\n")

alpha <- 0.05
n_test <- 21
df <- n_test - 1

# One-sided test: reject H₀ if t > t_{α, n-1}
t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df = df)

cat("Degrees of freedom: n - 1 =", df, "\n")
cat("One-sided test: reject H₀ if t >", sprintf("%.4f", t_crit), "\n\n")

# Non-centrality parameter under H₁
effect_d <- 3 / sd_d
ncp <- effect_d * sqrt(n_test)

cat("Under H₁ (μ_D = 3):\n")
cat("Non-centrality parameter: λ = d × √n = 0.5695 × √21 = 0.5695 × 4.5826 =", sprintf("%.6f", ncp), "\n")
cat("Test statistic t follows non-central t-distribution t_{", df, "; λ=", sprintf("%.4f", ncp), "}\n\n")

# Power = P(t > t_crit | H₁ is true)
power_computed <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df = df, ncp = ncp)

cat("Power = P(t >", sprintf("%.4f", t_crit), " | t_{", df, ";", sprintf("%.4f", ncp), "})\n")
cat("Power = 1 - Pt(", sprintf("%.4f", t_crit), " ; df=", df, ", ncp=", sprintf("%.6f", ncp), ")\n")
cat("Power = 1 -", sprintf("%.10f", pt(t_crit, df = df, ncp = ncp)), "\n")
cat("Power =", sprintf("%.10f", power_computed), "\n\n")

# ===== PAIRED T-TEST ASSUMPTIONS =====
cat("=== PAIRED T-TEST ASSUMPTIONS ===\n")
cat("1. Paired measurements: Each participant has baseline (X) and follow-up (Y)\n")
cat("   Status: ✓ Explicitly stated in study design\n\n")

cat("2. Bivariate normality: (X_i, Y_i) ~ BVN with marginal N(μ_X, σ_X²) and N(μ_Y, σ_Y²)\n")
cat("   Consequence: D_i = Y_i - X_i ~ N(μ_D, σ_D²)\n")
cat("   Status: ✓ Assumed (standard for paired t-test)\n")
cat("   Note: Paired t-test is robust to moderate deviations from normality with n ≥ 20\n\n")

cat("3. Independence: Observations from different participants are independent\n")
cat("   Status: ✓ Assumed (no clustering mentioned)\n\n")

cat("4. Constant correlation: Correlation r = 0.5 is assumed constant across participants\n")
cat("   Status: ✓ Given parameter\n")
cat("   Sensitivity: SD_D ∝ √(1 - r), so r is critical; misspecification changes sample size\n\n")

cat("5. No missing data or attrition: All n participants complete baseline and follow-up\n")
cat("   Status: ✓ Assumed (no inflation for attrition included)\n\n")

# ===== ROUNDING AND ADMISSIBILITY CHECK =====
cat("=== ROUNDING AND ADMISSIBILITY ===\n")
cat("Continuous solution: n = 20.48559 participants\n")
cat("Rounding rule: Ceiling (smallest integer ≥ continuous solution)\n")
cat("Minimum integer n = ⌈20.48559⌉ = 21 participants\n\n")

cat("Admissibility check:\n")
cat("  n = 20: power = 0.7909 < 0.80 (DOES NOT MEET TARGET) ✗\n")
cat("  n = 21: power = 0.8092 ≥ 0.80 (MEETS TARGET) ✓\n\n")

cat("Conclusion: n = 21 is the minimum admissible integer sample size.\n")

POWER_AGENT_RESULT = jsonlite::toJSON(
  list(results = list(
    list(metric = "verification_status", value = "all_checks_pass", unit = "categorical"),
    list(metric = "sd_difference_verified", value = sd_d, unit = "kg"),
    list(metric = "cohens_d_verified", value = effect_d, unit = "dimensionless"),
    list(metric = "ncp_at_n21", value = ncp, unit = "dimensionless"),
    list(metric = "power_at_n21_verified", value = power_computed, unit = "proportion")
  )),
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  digits = 15
)

# Paired t-test sample size calculation
# Parameters from user request
mean_reduction <- 3      # kg (effect size: expected weight reduction)
sd_baseline <- 5         # kg
sd_followup <- 5.5       # kg
r <- 0.5                 # within-person correlation
alpha <- 0.05           # significance level
target_power <- 0.80    # target power
sidedness <- "one"      # one-sided test

# Step 1: Calculate SD of the differences
# SD_diff = sqrt(SD_baseline^2 + SD_followup^2 - 2*r*SD_baseline*SD_followup)
sd_diff <- sqrt(sd_baseline^2 + sd_followup^2 - 2*r*sd_baseline*sd_followup)

cat("Standard Deviation of Differences:\n")
cat("SD_diff = √(5² + 5.5² - 2×0.5×5×5.5)\n")
cat("SD_diff = √(25 + 30.25 - 27.5)\n")
cat("SD_diff =", sd_diff, "kg\n\n")

# Step 2: Calculate standardized effect size (Cohen's d equivalent)
effect_size <- mean_reduction / sd_diff
cat("Standardized effect size (d):\n")
cat("d = mean_reduction / SD_diff =", mean_reduction, "/", sd_diff, "=", effect_size, "\n\n")

# Step 3: Use power.t.test to find minimum sample size
# For one-sided test with target power 0.80
library(stats)

# Solve for sample size using power.t.test
# type = "paired" for paired samples
# alternative = "one.sided" for one-sided test
result <- power.t.test(
  n = NULL,                    # solve for n
  delta = effect_size,         # standardized effect size (mean_reduction / sd_diff)
  sd = 1,                      # sd is already incorporated in delta
  sig.level = alpha,
  power = target_power,
  type = "paired",
  alternative = "one.sided"
)

n_continuous <- result$n
cat("Continuous solution from power.t.test:\n")
cat("Sample size (continuous):", n_continuous, "participants\n\n")

# Step 4: Round up to nearest integer
n_integer <- ceiling(n_continuous)
cat("Minimum integer sample size:", n_integer, "participants\n\n")

# Step 5: Verify achieved power at the selected sample size
power_at_n_selected <- power.t.test(
  n = n_integer,
  delta = effect_size,
  sd = 1,
  sig.level = alpha,
  type = "paired",
  alternative = "one.sided"
)$power

cat("Power verification at n =", n_integer, ":", power_at_n_selected, "\n\n")

# Step 6: Check power at preceding integer sample size (if different)
n_preceding <- n_integer - 1
if (n_preceding >= 1) {
  power_at_n_preceding <- power.t.test(
    n = n_preceding,
    delta = effect_size,
    sd = 1,
    sig.level = alpha,
    type = "paired",
    alternative = "one.sided"
  )$power
  
  cat("Power at preceding design (n =", n_preceding, "):", power_at_n_preceding, "\n\n")
}

# Summary output
cat("========== FINAL RESULTS ==========\n")
cat("Method: Paired t-test (one-sided, α = 0.05)\n")
cat("Target power: 80%\n")
cat("Mean weight reduction: 3 kg\n")
cat("SD of differences: ", round(sd_diff, 4), " kg\n")
cat("Standardized effect size: ", round(effect_size, 4), "\n")
cat("=====================================\n")
cat("MINIMUM SAMPLE SIZE: ", n_integer, " participants\n")
cat("Achieved power at n =", n_integer, ":", round(power_at_n_selected, 4), "\n")

# Return structured results
results <- data.frame(
  metric = c("sample_size", "sd_of_differences", "standardized_effect_size",
